hypotheses.persona: A retired or semi-retired individual who enjoys a leisurely morning routine with coffee, reading glasses, and a newspaper, followed by a simple lunch at home, and spends afternoons relaxing in the living room.
hypotheses.rationale: Day 13 (Sunday) continues the same pattern: reading_glasses at counter at 06:30, moved to table at 06:56; coffee_mug at sink at 10:49 (after morning coffee); phone on sofa at 14:03 (afternoon relaxation); dishes put away at 21:45. No work objects appear. The consistency across 14 days (including weekends) strongly supports a non-working, health-conscious resident with a fixed daily routine.

hypotheses.persona: A remote worker who starts the day with coffee and reading but takes a break to have lunch at home and then works from the living room in the afternoon.
